title: Fix context compactor memory loss, in-chat card display, and 100% full gauge bug
summary: Fixed context compactor amnesia by enhancing LLM prompts and eliminating generic placeholder stubs in fallback compaction report to extract actual tool calls, commands, tests, and active todos. Preserved the last 4 messages (2 full recent turns) during compaction. Emitted and persisted first-class visible in-chat compact_context tool cards with localized metrics into SQLite dialog_items. Resolved the 100% full gauge overflow bug upon drawer re-entry by persisting task.current_tokens on disk/memory, fixing drawerStore dialogue reload dropping compacted items, and preventing uncompressed character sum recalculation in ContextGauge.
